title: Hidden Talks: Lawsuits, Land, and Staff
summary:
*   Austin officials convened a special, brief meeting to conduct an Executive Session behind closed doors.
*   The private discussions covered legal advice, potential land acquisition, and personnel matters.
*   Key litigation cases were reviewed, including disputes with Gemini Exploration Company and John H. Young, Inc.
*   No final public decisions or votes were taken during this short session.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING - March 05, 1992
OFFICE OF THE MAYOR - 11:00 A.M.
Mayor Todd called to order the meeting of the Council, noting the absence of Mayor Pro
Tern Urdy and Councilmember Garcia.
The Mayor announced Council would enter into Executive Session pursuant to Article
6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated to receive advice from Legal Counsel, to
discuss matters of land acquisition, litigation and personnel matters. No final action,
decision or vote by the City Council will be taken on any subject or matter unless
specifically listed on the agenda for this meeting.
Pending/Contemplated Litigation - Section 2, Paragraph e 1.
Discussion of Gemini Exploration Company et al v. City of Austin and Lover Colorado River
Authority, Cause No. 91-143 and City of Austin v. Gemini Exploration Company et al, Cause
No. 11935. 2.
Discussion of City of Austin v. John H. Young, Inc., Cause No. 91-11579.
Council entered Executive Session at 11*08 A.M. and adjourned its meeting at Hi 33 A.M.
MINUTES
3/5/92
